policy: Similar names and shared vendors are not proof of the same product. Retain listing provenance; merge only on explicit official evidence. Redirects identify current destinations, not automatic historical feature parity.

decisions.decision: Nektony's App Cleaner & Uninstaller is a component offered in the MacCleaner Pro bundle, not an alias for the entire bundle. Compare the actual product/workflow scope; do not merge solely because the vendor is shared.

decisions.excerpt: Mac Cleaner Pro can permanently and easily shred files and folders
decisions.additionalExcerpt: A bundle of six professional tools for a deep Mac cleanup.
decisions.decision: IUWEsoft's file cleaner/shredder and Nektony's MacCleaner Pro suite have separate current official identities. Similar product spelling does not justify merging; retain vendor-qualified names.

decisions.decision: Retain the two independently documented current official offerings with vendor/domain-qualified names. No same-product relationship established; do not merge solely from the Dusty name.

Distinct current official product pages and documented cleaner versus maintenance-suite scope. Shared vendor/navigation does not establish an alias. Keep product-qualified comparisons.

decisions.decision: Legacy listing/generation names and vendor pointer do not establish identical versions, historical feature parity or discontinuation. Do not generate separate near-identical pages for OS-version labels without distinct current scope; per-product research must resolve or skip them.
